historical_phenomenon: Open-medial syncope after a heavy initial syllable before a still-heavy following syllable, contrasted with retention before light final u.
conditioning: Short unstressed medial vowel in an open syllable; initial and following syllable weights, with no case, lexical or inflection-class conditions.
executable_implementation: Immutable A, B and C models in experiment.py; no production modification. Explicit ending sensitivity tests final nasal bimoric unrounding.
selected_input_assumptions: Current soul2201 remains inherited nominative *sáiwalō -> sāwol. Preferred future cell is inherited feminine accusative *sáiwalǭ -> sāwle.
firing_census: Baseline SC036 changes soul and world only. Every experimental stage firing and selected/immutable final delta is in results.json.gz; complete summary in results.md.
positive_witnesses: Inherited accusative produces sāwle in A, explicit-unrounded A and C-nonhigh
Independent idle/head retention versus heavy-ending syncope

negative_controls.description: Light following u retains medial vowel and blocks H-L-L apocope
Closed, long and accented medial vowels retained by syncope
Prematurely shortened ending does not falsely yield sāwle
Complete eādigu vowel-quality derivation in model A
All protected selected outputs preserved by broad replacement

counterfactual_results: Removing proxy alone gives sāwel, not a historical solution. B gives sāwl without new insertion, while broad l-insertion recovers sāwol but overgenerates felel/healel. See complete traces.
historical_vs_modelling: Accusative history is source-supported; current late symbolic nasal-vowel carrying and support-stage quantity are implementation choices. Nominal analogy remains outside the phonological transducer. Known Foma diagnostic limitations are not historical evidence.
